en.headline: Guangdong yachts expected to sail in Hong Kong waters from October
en.dek: Transport chief Mable Chan said the southbound scheme is close to launch after the Marine Department prepares to sign arrangements with Guangdong authorities.
body: Guangdong-registered yachts are expected to be allowed to sail in Hong Kong waters from as early as October under a new southbound travel scheme, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday.

Chan said the Marine Department and the Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration would soon finalise two working arrangements covering both northbound Hong Kong yachts and southbound Guangdong vessels. Details would be announced in due course.

The measure forms part of efforts outlined in the Policy Address and Hong Kong’s first five-year plan to develop the yacht economy and boost cross-boundary leisure spending. Northbound travel for Hong Kong and Macao yachts into nine Greater Bay Area cities has already begun, with the first sailings in June.
Facilitation steps already in place include examinations for mainland skippers on Hong Kong waters knowledge that can be taken on the mainland, designated anchorages and a dynamic monitoring system.

zh.headline: 粵艇南下最快10月實施 陳美寶：詳情稍後公布
zh.dek: 海事處將與廣東海事局簽署工作安排，配合五年規劃發展遊艇經濟及跨境休閒消費。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周六表示，廣東註冊遊艇南下香港水域的安排最快可於10月實施。
她指海事處將與廣東海事局很快簽署兩項工作安排，涵蓋港艇北上及粵艇南下，詳情會適時公布。
措施配合施政報告及香港首個五年規劃，旨在發展遊艇經濟及帶動跨境休閒消費。港澳遊艇進入大灣區九市的北上安排已於6月展開首航。
當局已推出便利措施，包括內地船長可在內地考取香港水域知識評核、指定錨泊區及動態實時監管系統。
